milestone.title: mp autopilot reviewer execution isolation + clean-room policy

intent.outcome: Each automated review runs in a recorded, reproducible environment that prevents runner process state or build-cache ambiguity from masquerading as independent evidence.

problem.description: Herdr review cycles may inherit process state, workspace dirt, or stale build products. Unconditionally cleaning every cycle is expensive, so review isolation and clean-room escalation need a dedicated policy and evidence contract.

in_scope: Fresh reviewer process with recorded binary/worktree/target-dir provenance.
Normal isolated-target mode and configurable clean-room mode using cargo clean only when requested or provenance checks fail.
Pre-review dirty-worktree and runner/reviewer independence checks.
out_of_scope: Crash/restart reconciliation and final full-drive certification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Normal review mode launches a fresh reviewer process with independent actor identity, records binary/worktree/target-dir provenance, and does not reuse runner-local process state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/m224_ac01/)' exit 0 (4/4 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Clean-room mode runs only when configured or provenance/cache checks fail, records the reason and commands, and never makes unconditional cargo clean the default.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/m224_ac02/)' exit 0 (5/5 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Dirty worktree, shared actor identity, stale binary, or unverifiable environment blocks automatic review pass with an actionable typed result.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/m224_ac03/)' exit 0 (11/11 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Default to a fresh reviewer process and isolated target directory; run cargo clean only under explicit clean-room policy or failed provenance checks.
design_decisions.rationale: Independent evidence requires process isolation, while unconditional cold builds add cost without guaranteeing correctness.

work_packages.name: Reviewer environment policy
work_packages.goal: Launch and verify independent review environments with recorded provenance and bounded clean-room escalation.
work_packages.rollback: Disable automated review pass and require explicit human review.

steps.action: Implement reviewer environment builder with fresh process, actor identity, worktree, target directory, and binary provenance.
Implement normal and clean-room policy selection with recorded trigger and no unconditional cargo clean.
steps.done_when: AC-02 proves both modes and trigger evidence.

steps.action: Gate automatic review pass on clean worktree, distinct actor, and compatible binary/environment provenance.

findings.description: Gate does not compare env.worktree_path against the runner's worktree. ReviewerProvenance carries worktree_path and exposes worktree_matches() but GateInputs has no runner_worktree_path field and the gate never invokes the accessor. If a reviewer is spawned on a different worktree (stale checkout, secondary clone), it would silently review different code while binary_sha / target_dir / pid / actor all check out. Contradicts the spec's 'runner/reviewer independence checks' phrasing and is a structural isolation gap.
findings.author: reviewer-224

findings.description: The gate's PassWithCleanRoom escalation on shared pid (review_env.rs:645-658) is untested. Unit tests in s3_tests cover shared-target-dir escalation but not shared-pid; integration tests in m224_ac03 also lack this case. AC-03 advertises 10/10 gate coverage but this critical safety path (reviewer process is the runner process) has no test asserting the typed decision / reason / commands. The implementation may be silently wrong on this path.
findings.author: reviewer-224
